# `help`

Rank operations/workflows for a plain-English request. Never invokes an operation.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice help`
- **MCP tool:** `help`

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | `str` | required | Plain-English description of what you want to do |

## Examples

```
operator-voice help --request "make this slack message sound like me"
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |

## Plain-language aliases

- "what can you do"
- "how do i"
- "help me"
